theory.title: Used to y would para hábitos pasados
theory.explanation: Usa used to + infinitivo para hábitos y estados pasados que ya no son ciertos. Would + infinitivo describe acciones repetidas en el pasado, pero normalmente no se utiliza para estados. Usa el pasado simple para acontecimientos únicos y terminados.
theory.tip: Used to sirve para hábitos y estados pasados; would para acciones repetidas. No uses would para describir estados como ser o tener.

content.passage: When Ben started his first job, he used to check his emails late at night. He would often stay in the office after everyone else had left, and he rarely took a proper lunch break. After a few months, he realised that he was always tired. He spoke to his manager and agreed on a more flexible schedule. Now he finishes work on time and goes swimming twice a week. He still works hard, but he has learned to make time for friends and family.
